name: Marelli
note: Technical partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to magnetimarelli.com, stands under 'Technical partners' with the line 'Data acquisition systems' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Also a 2026 TOYOTA RACING (WEC) partner (team media kit p.18; toyota-racing.com partners section). Ownership in transition: Marelli (created by KKR in 2019) filed for Chapter 11 in June 2025 and expects to emerge under a consortium of its principal lenders (reported by autobodynews.com and others); no current ownership claim could be sourced, so it stays not rated yet.
